limitations: Local PGlite emulates auth.uid and auth.users; pgcrypto extension omitted in favour of native gen_random_uuid.
No JWT/PostgREST, real owner login, live migration or external side effect.
Single-engine serialized tests do not prove concurrent multi-session lock behavior.
Synthetic numeric recheck is a human-supplied observation, not independent bank verification.
Deterministic reviewer templates and reviewed procedural retrieval, not LLM reasoning or general learning.
